'''Drake Squadron''' was a fictitious [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]] unit that supposedly belonged to [[Zsinj]], but whose members were actually [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Wraith Squadron]].

==History==
Four [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] belonging to Drake Squadron landed on [[Kidriff 5]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] to help cover the retreat of the ''[[Millennium Falsehood]]''

==Organization==
The four known fighters of Drake Squadron were led by [[Kell Tainer]], and they all posed as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officers in need of recreation.

==Equipment==
Drake Squadron was equipped with TIE interceptors, which their pilots initially flew as if they were equipped with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] and [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputers]]. However, they were not.
